big: A caller says, 'Guaranteed 24% a year in our private PMS. Invest today.' Every part of that is a warning sign. PMS and AIFs are market-linked, so returns cannot be guaranteed.

lines: Guaranteed or assured returns. Unregistered portfolio managers, so verify on SEBI's website. Pressure to invest fast, claims of inside information, or returns that look too steady. Hidden or unusually high fees, or refusal to share the Disclosure Document or PPM. Report suspicious offers through SEBI's SCORES system and to the exchange.

rows: no Disclosure Document or PPM, hidden or high fees
note: Report suspicious offers to SEBI SCORES and the exchange.
